''See also: [[Blackwatch Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Blackwatch, also known as the Blackwatch [[Guild]], is one of the [[Imperial Guilds]]. Established by the Emperor to utilize the power of the [[Elders]] against themselves, the organization's primary mission is to study [[Elders]] for the benefit of humanity. Their guiding creed emphasizes that through understanding, they can control the unknown. They serve as guardians who protect the general population from unspeakable threats, though they are often viewed with fear or suspicion by the public. Some even perceive them as potential cultists of the [[Elders]]. Members, known as [[Watchmen]], are easily identified by their distinctive black uniforms and long coats featuring silver buttons. Their crest, known as the Elder’s Eyes, depicts six inhuman eyes atop a nest of tentacles. [[The Guild]] utilizes specialized weaponry, specifically black [[Iron|iron]] spikes or nails invested with unique [[Intent]], which are highly effective at pinning down and sealing [[Elderspawn]]. [[The Guild]] is led by a Head, currently [[Bliss of the Blackwatch|Bliss]], who is supported by her second-in-command, [[Alsa Grayweather]]. The Blackwatch operates as a disciplined and regimented force capable of large-scale mobilization. While they have historically cooperated with other [[Imperial Guilds]] to maintain security regarding [[Great Elders]], recent conflicts known as the [[Guild War]] have strained these relationships, leading to increased tension and hostility between the Blackwatch and other orders.}}

== Of Sea and Shadow ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|The Blackwatch is an organization founded by the Emperor to turn the power of the [[Elders]] against them for the good of humanity. Composed of soldiers in black uniforms and coats, the group defends people against the [[hunger]] of the [[Elders]] by capturing, examining, and fishing for them in the [[Aion Sea]]. While they provide help and maintain driftwood shelters, the group is not held in high public opinion due to rumors that they worship [[Elders]] and drink human blood. Although their [[Authority|authority]] is limited to emergencies or [[Guild]]-sanctioned assignments, members can order citizens to act regarding Elder magic or [[Elderspawn]]. [[Calder]] has been a member of this guild for some time, an organization that uses [[The Testament]] and commissions confidential reports to manage the [[Elders]].}}

== Of Shadow and Sea ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|The Blackwatch is an organization identified by their silver-buttoned black coats and the Elder Eyes crest. Members are stationed on the western side of [[Nakothi's island]], where Clayborn intends to rendezvous with them. While the guild has faced sabotage from [[Yala the High Mason|Yala]] and betrayal by the Watchman, they remain in conflict with the [[Luminian Order]]. == Of Dawn and Darkness ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|The Blackwatch is an organization within the Imperialist alliance that studies [[Elders]] in service of humanity and provides protection to the people. Comprised of predecessors to [[Bliss of the Blackwatch|Bliss]] and including [[Jerri's father]], this group receives reports and can be summoned through official [[Guild]] action. While they perform tests on Elder creatures and have commissioned research into the properties of the [[Sandborn Hydra]], they also enforce discipline by feeding those who breach conduct to the [[Elderspawn]]. As one of the groups mobilized by the Emperor to manage Elder activity, they arrived in a region where an [[Elderspawn]] infection had already spread. Though [[Imperial Steward Calder Marten|Calder Marten]] spent two years with the organization, he was eventually expelled, despite the Blackwatch declining to formally register charges against him after previously hunting him.}}

== Of Darkness and Dawn ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|Historically, the ancient Blackwatch functioned by capturing [[Elders]] and executing those who were Elder-touched. This group, which possesses knowledge regarding extended lifespans and the ability to travel, is often mentioned alongside [[Nakothi]]. While they have recently lost contact, the organization is typically led by a woman whose unpredictable [[Blackwatch Guild Head|Guild Head]] can cause instability. Currently, the Blackwatch is engaged in cleansing the Capital of [[Elderspawn]] and is among the factions expected to launch an attack on [[Gray Island]]. [[Darius Allbright|Darius]] has previously encountered them in combat, noting their ranks include members such as a girl wielding a spear.}}

== Of Kings and Killers ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The Blackwatch is a disciplined, regimented army that operates like a militia and wears long black coats adorned with silver buttons. Guided by the principle that [[Elders]] must be studied to be opposed, the group has successfully disproved most superstitions regarding Elder names and recovered a fragment of pottery from the [[Thousand Eyes]]. While they have used an inn as their headquarters and can be seen securing buildings in flocks, the organization is also associated with seven spikes. Members such as [[Bliss of the Blackwatch|Bliss]] belong to the group, and some watchmen even develop a [[Reader's sense]]. Historically, [[Calder]] worked for the Blackwatch in his youth, and the Head of the organization has vouched for him.}}

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The [[Blackwatch]] studies [[Elders]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c3">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 3</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The [[Blackwatch]] is a group that [[Calder]]'s mother can represent.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c4">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 4</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The [[Blackwatch]] is a disciplined, regimented army wearing long, black, silver-buttoned coats.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c6">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 6</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The [[Blackwatch Guild Head|Head of the Blackwatch]] has vouched for [[Calder]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c6" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|A flock of [[Blackwatch]] is holding a building secure.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c7">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 7</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The [[Blackwatch]] used an inn as their headquarters.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c7" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Blackwatch]] has disproved most superstitions about Elder names.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c8">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 8</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Watchmen]] in the [[Blackwatch]] sometimes develop a [[Reader's sense]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c11">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 11</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The [[Blackwatch]] is described as acting like a militia.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c13">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 13</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Calder]] worked for the [[Blackwatch]] in his youth.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c15">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 15</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The [[Blackwatch]] is associated with seven spikes.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c20">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 20</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Blackwatch]] is a group that [[Bliss of the Blackwatch|Bliss]] belongs to.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c23">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 23</ref>}}</li>
</ul></div>

== Of Killers and Kings ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Blackwatch is an army of fighters who operate alongside the [[Luminian|Luminians]]. During a confrontation, members of this group were seen pulling nails from their coats while surrounded by their own dead or dying comrades. As part of a panel established by [[Calder]] to counter various reports, the group also manages specific duties regarding ancient sites. This includes performing monthly inspections of [[Urg’naut]]'s tomb, a task that highlights the difficulties the Blackwatch has faced with tombs.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">7</span></div>

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Yala the High Mason|Yala]] was surrounded by dead or dying [[Blackwatch]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c8" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Blackwatch]] is an army.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c8" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Blackwatch]] is part of a panel formed by [[Calder]] to counter reports.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c14">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 14</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Blackwatch]] has had trouble with tombs.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c20">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 20</ref>}}</li>

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Blackwatch]] is a group of fighters fighting alongside [[Luminian|Luminians]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c23">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 23</ref>}}</li>

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|“I’m surprised your father didn’t tell you. What did you think I did for the Blackwatch?”<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c4" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|“They defend us from the Elders,” Jyrine said.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c6" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|“They worship Elders and drink human blood,” Calder whispered.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c6" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|“I’ve never heard, except that it involves something called a Whispering Gaunt.”<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c6" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|“And this is exactly what the Blackwatch was founded to do. Turn the powers of the Elders to the good of humanity.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c9" />}}
